src/app/api/admin/rotate-master-key/init.reason: Reads the tenant's ACTIVE OWNER/ADMIN memberships (deactivatedAt: null) to notify approvers; an active member's owning column is the one the realignment keeps on this tenant.

src/app/api/scim/v2/Groups/route.ts.reason: Both member reads require an active membership in the authenticated tenant as a relation filter (user.tenantMemberships.some). A team guest is excluded by design, and a user this context cannot see is excluded by that filter before any email is read.

src/app/api/share-links/mine/route.ts.reason: `where` (typed Prisma.PasswordShareWhereInput) starts empty and is assembled per context and status. The keys it can set: teamPasswordEntry (a TeamPasswordEntry relation, { teamId }), createdById, passwordEntryId, shareType, teamPasswordEntryId, revokedAt, expiresAt. None is the required createdBy relation; the creator is hydrated after the context closes.

src/app/api/share-links/route.ts.reason: GET's `where` starts as { createdById: session user } and conditionally adds passwordEntryId and teamPasswordEntryId. All three are scalar columns.

src/app/api/tenant/breakglass/route.ts.reason: The grant target must hold an ACTIVE membership here (deactivatedAt: null) before a grant is created.

src/app/api/tenant/members/[userId]/rese.reason: Reads the reset target's ACTIVE membership (deactivatedAt: null).
The reset target's ACTIVE membership, and the tenant's other ACTIVE OWNER/ADMIN memberships for approver notifications (both deactivatedAt: null).

src/app/api/tenant/members/[userId]/rout.reason: Role updates on the target membership the same request has just read with deactivatedAt: null.

src/app/api/tenant/service-accounts/rout.reason: The create returns its creator, who is the requesting user (createdById: session.user.id) and visible in their own tenant context.

src/lib/auth/webauthn/webauthn-server.ts.reason: verifyAssertionCore's credential lookup uses `where: buildWhere(responseCredentialId)`, whose return type is declared as `{ id, userId, credentialId } | { userId, credentialId }` — scalar columns only, enforced by the type rather than by this entry.

src/lib/emergency-access/vault-auto-prom.reason: Its only caller, api/emergency-access/[id]/vault, runs it inside withBypassRls and hands it that transaction.

src/lib/services/scim-group-service.ts.reason: loadGroupMembers requires an active membership in the tenant as a relation filter; the same restriction as the Groups route entry.
